verdicts.defold-depth-of-field-shader: no license file at 97945c1 or main head and GitHub reports none, so its Lua cannot be vendored for a parity floor
verdicts.defold-graph-pathfinder: closed-source license at 0.0.4 grants no right to redistribute its source, so no registering C++ can be vendored for a parity floor
verdicts.defpro: profiler.capture first reads /profile_strings and /profile_frame, which the engine no longer serves (profiling moved to Remotery), so at 1.1.1 every capture fails its STRS assert and never calls back
verdicts.dirtylarry: no license file at 09d07c6 (master head) and GitHub reports none, so its Lua cannot be vendored for a parity floor
verdicts.googleanalytics: sends Universal Analytics Measurement Protocol v1 hits (v=1, a UA- tracking id) to google-analytics.com/batch; Google stopped processing Universal Analytics data in 2023-2024 and a GA4 property takes no UA- id, so at 1.4.1 no hit reaches a report
verdicts.log: its one module log/log.lua is required as log.log, the require path and log/ folder Insality/defold-log already owns, so its surface would merge into that declaration and no project can depend on both
verdicts.physics-tools: editor script with plugin binaries, no runtime module
verdicts.pp: script components driven by messages: a project posts pp_init, pp_join and pp_message to pp/master.script, and pp.json and pp.base64 are helpers only master.script requires, no module a project requires
verdicts.sonilo: editor script whose runtime piece is a script component, no module to require
verdicts.trenchbroom: import tool: an editor script and a desktop-Lua cli.lua convert TrenchBroom .map files to collections, no runtime module
verdicts.vantage: script component driven by go.set properties; vantage_core.lua is required only by vantage_component.script, no module a project requires
verdicts.vibration: no license file at 0.2.1 or master head and GitHub reports none, so its registering C++ cannot be vendored for a parity floor
verdicts.wortal: v3.0.3 (equal to master) does not compile for HTML5, the only platform that registers wortal: src/wortal.cpp:87-88 call the undeclared lua_pushListener and lua_pushBoolean
